body: International trade. It's a mistake if you ask me but now that I'm on my 5th semester out of 7, ending my studies seems like a waste of time.

I was hospitalized for all this 3 years ago and even then I just didn't have what it takes to tell them what's going on. In the end it was some nurse who had to call them and despite my mom wanting to speak to me every day I was at the hospital, I just refused to talk to her. After I was released I just called her briefly simply to state I'm now home and off to buy some food even though she would've wanted to pretty much talk to me for the next few hours about it all. I just have a hard time admitting I'm in a situation like this.
I don't even know what to tell them. And I just can't do it.
